in_sanskrit.name: Mathan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Thoughts
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mathan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Matr' meaning 'Thought' and 'Manas' meaning 'Mind'. Mathan is the one who controls and manages thoughts.

in_hindi.name: Mathan
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Thoughts
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mathan एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Matr' meaning 'Thought' and 'Manas' meaning 'Mind'. Mathan is the one who controls and manages thoughts.

in_telugu.name: Mathan
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of Thoughts
in_telugu.long_meaning: Mathan ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Matr' meaning 'Thought' and 'Manas' meaning 'Mind'. Mathan is the one who controls and manages thoughts.

in_marathi.name: Mathan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Thoughts
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mathan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Matr' meaning 'Thought' and 'Manas' meaning 'Mind'. Mathan is the one who controls and manages thoughts.

in_bengali.name: Mathan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Thoughts
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mathan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Matr' meaning 'Thought' and 'Manas' meaning 'Mind'. Mathan is the one who controls and manages thoughts.
